data.title: 诀 · 应龙关雾山石台巡望
data.action: 立于云雾石台边缘迎风回眸目光冷峻
data.lighting: 清冷柔和的阴天高地散射光与雾气轮廓光
data.description: 山雾在青石栏杆外缓慢翻涌，李织烟一袭黑衣青衬的应龙特勤长外套被山风掀起衣角。她收起望向北部禁区方向的视线，微微侧身看过来，眉心细长的红印在冷白晨雾间显得格外清晰——「风势稳了。你若随行，便跟紧我的步距。」
data.promptProse: Standing composed upon a mist-shrouded stone mountain terrace with cool wind lifting her dark tactical coat and aqua-tipped ponytail, Arcane looks calmly toward the viewer under soft overcast highland light.
data.animaCaption: She stands composed on the misty stone terrace as mountain wind lifts her long coat and ponytail.
